Services

Everything we offer is grounded in classical Ayurvedic texts and adapted to modern lifestyles.

Vamana

Therapeutic emesis for Kapha disorders, skin issues, and respiratory conditions.

Virechana

Controlled purgation for Pitta imbalances, liver detox, and chronic skin diseases.

Basti

Medicated enemas — the cornerstone of Vata treatment. Highly effective for spine and neurological issues.

Nasya

Nasal administration of medicines for sinusitis, migraines, and cervical problems.

Raktamokshana

Bloodletting for localized inflammatory conditions when indicated.
